description: BASE-002 fail: the same branch with the tip commit object truncated (truncateCommit HEAD). git merge-base cannot read it and exits 128, which used to be read as no integration branch: the AmendmentAuthority failure said no integration branch to diff against and that the check does not distinguish a truncated clone from unrelated histories, and the warning advised fetching more history. It now says the diff base could not be read, names git's failure and the repair; the numbered lane stays red, exit 1.
